prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 2 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1075; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: The patient presented after a side-impact collision at an intersection with complaints of neck and back pain consistent with soft tissue strain. Two office visits were completed. Examination documented paraspinal muscle tenderness and restricted range of motion in the cervical and lumbar regions. Imaging studies were obtained and their findings clearly confirm the presence of the injury being treated. The patient reports no prior injury or treatment involving the same body areas. Care followed a typical conservative course, including rest, anti-inflammatory medication, and home stretching, and symptoms gradually tapered as the patient improved. At this point it is not yet clear whether the injury is entirely attributable to this collision, and further records would be needed to assess causation. Billing records reflect a single charge for each service, with no repeated or duplicate entries.
